# The Paul Davis Partnership

> Full-service architecture and planning firm serving Monterey County and California's Central Coast since 1984. Work spans custom homes, historic restoration, mixed-use, affordable and senior housing, hospitality, commercial and civic buildings.

Phone: (831) 373-2784
Principals: Paul E. Davis AIA (Partner, Retired); Paul W. Davis AIA (Partner, Principal Architect, Design & Programming)

## Firm

- [Home](https://pauldavispartnership.com/): Overview, mission, values and expertise
- [Philosophy & Team](https://pauldavispartnership.com/philosophy/): Principals, staff and design philosophy
- [Design Process](https://pauldavispartnership.com/design/): Conceptual design through construction
- [Sustainable Design](https://pauldavispartnership.com/sustainability/): Green building approach and Go Green Guide
- [Contact](https://pauldavispartnership.com/contact/): Direct phone extensions and email for each team member

## Projects

- [All projects](https://pauldavispartnership.com/projects/): Portfolio filterable by category
- [Holman Ranch, Carmel Valley](https://pauldavispartnership.com/holman-ranch-carmel-valley/): Historic restoration of a 1928 hacienda
- [286 Eldorado Street](https://pauldavispartnership.com/286-eldorado-street/): Mixed-use offices and residence, completed 2000
- [Castro Plaza](https://pauldavispartnership.com/castro-plaza/): 16,000 SF civic project with library and county offices, completed 2007
- [La Gloria Senior Apartments](https://pauldavispartnership.com/la-gloria-senior-apartments/): 23-unit senior housing, completed 2011
- [Oak Park Community, Paso Robles](https://pauldavispartnership.com/oak-park-community-paso-robles/): 300+ unit affordable housing community, completed 2020
- [Santa Lucia Preserve Residence](https://pauldavispartnership.com/sainta-lucia-preserve-1/): 8,400 SF hillside home in Carmel Valley
